title: Deterministic development verification and GitHub governance
user_story: As repository owner I can request a feature by chat and require reproducible independent gates before any dev merge or release.

requirements.description: Conservatively select affected tests; never narrow mandatory PR/full gates
Aggregate root failures with exact case IDs and raw evidence
Fail closed on missing checks and invalid branch promotion
Stop after three failed repair cycles per stable task/PR
Require reviewed feature contracts and executable requirement traceability

nonfunctional: No LLM calls for selection, parsing, reporting or retry accounting
Source/environment provenance and bounded console logs
Never delete skills/ or agent/; never weaken 100% release coverage
preconditions: Preserved dirty work and branch SHAs
Pinned GitHub skills selected before implementation
postconditions: CI alone never promotes missing live/scientific qualification
No application Research Harness imports from development infrastructure
dependencies: GitHub Actions hosted runners; real AI requires separately authorized trusted infrastructure
acceptance_criteria: All named contract tests execute and pass
The same PR source must satisfy every independent required check
Absent 100% production coverage blocks PR/QA/release; no waiver introduced
Real provider results remain separate from deterministic unit doubles

scenarios.expected: 50 identical root exceptions retain 50 IDs and one group
Absent or nonpassing mandatory checks block
A fourth failed repair is prohibited across changed heads
Corrupt persistent state blocks further repairs
Traceability points to actual executable test symbols
Untraced or missing test cases are rejected
Only intended promotion direction and human release pass

recovery: Inspect concise fingerprints; preserve failing evidence; target failed cases then affected suite; max three automatic repair cycles, then stop and report.
test_environment: Disposable directories and local subprocess fixtures; no paid provider calls.

review.method: Same-agent adversarial review; no independent reviewer or user approval fabricated

tdd.scope: Malformed-field validation case plus initial 16 harness tests; not retrospective certification of application code.
